title: MFA enforced for privileged users
risk_reduced: A stolen password alone can't take over an admin account.
test_logic: Every Okta user marked privileged has MFA enabled
last_detail: 3 of 3 in scope meet the rule

title: Access removed within 1 day of termination
risk_reduced: Shrinks the window in which a former employee could still log in.
test_logic: Every termination has access removed no more than 1 day later
last_detail: 2 of 3 in scope meet the rule

title: Cloud storage encryption enabled
risk_reduced: Stolen storage media or snapshots are unreadable.
test_logic: Every AWS bucket has default encryption
last_detail: 3 of 3 in scope meet the rule

title: Public storage buckets prohibited
risk_reduced: Data can't leak just because someone made a bucket public.
test_logic: No Google Cloud bucket is public
last_detail: 2 of 3 in scope meet the rule

title: Logging enabled for critical systems
risk_reduced: Incidents on critical systems can be detected and investigated.
test_logic: Every critical AWS trail is logging
last_detail: 1 of 1 in scope meet the rule

title: User access reviewed every 90 days
risk_reduced: Stale access is found and removed before someone misuses it.
test_logic: Every in-scope application had an access review in the last 90 days
last_detail: 3 of 4 in scope meet the rule

title: Security training completion at least 95%
risk_reduced: Fewer people click the phishing link that starts most breaches.
test_logic: At least 95% of active employees completed security training

title: Critical vendors reviewed before renewal
risk_reduced: We never commit another year to a vendor whose security we haven't checked.
test_logic: Every critical vendor's review was completed before its renewal date
last_detail: 2 of 2 in scope meet the rule

title: Row Level Security on every table
risk_reduced: A signed-in user can only reach the rows a policy allows, even if the app has a bug.
test_logic: Live: every table in the public schema has Row Level Security enabled
last_detail: 9 of 9 tables have Row Level Security on

title: Audit log can't be altered
risk_reduced: The record of who did what survives even a mistake or a malicious insider.
test_logic: Live: the audit log blocks updates, deletes and truncation, and no client can write to it
last_detail: Updates, deletes and truncation are blocked; no client can write to it

title: GRC analysts use MFA
risk_reduced: The people who can approve tests and close risks can't be impersonated with a password alone.
test_logic: Live: every user with the GRC analyst role has a verified MFA factor
last_detail: 1 of 1 GRC analysts have verified MFA

title: No policy opens a table to everyone
risk_reduced: Turning RLS on isn't enough: a policy of "true" or "any signed-in user" would still expose every row, the pattern behind CVE-2025-48757.
test_logic: Live: no policy allows every row, only checks that someone is signed in, or applies to anonymous visitors, and anonymous visitors have no table rights
last_detail: 11 policies checked: none opens a table to everyone or to any signed-in user
